name: Françoise Bettencourt Meyers

lifetimeGiving.source: No consolidated personal lifetime figure found. Foundation (co-founded by her with her parents, 1987) reports annual mecenat of 85.1M EUR in 2024 and 68.6M EUR in 2023; foundation gave 100M EUR to Notre-Dame restoration.

onTheRecord.finding: Foundation's 2024 activity report: total mecenat activity 85.1M EUR (life sciences 16.1M, crafts/metiers d'art 4.4M, choral 3M, solidarity 11.4M; remainder incl. large operations such as Notre-Dame). 2023: 68.6M EUR (prizes 8.6M, gifts 55.5M).

Foundation is a top contributor to Notre-Dame de Paris reconstruction with a 100M EUR gift (press release 3 June 2024). Forbes: L'Oreal plus the family agreed to donate about USD 226M for Notre-Dame after the 2019 fire.

Endowment not stated in accessible 2024 report summary; French Wikipedia cites a Paris Match (2017) figure of roughly 900M EUR budget/endowment and ~500M EUR distributed cumulatively by 2017 - secondary, not verified against foundation accounts.

notes: Forbes real-time profile 9/6/26: $95.6B, #22 in world; profile lists her as president of the family foundation; no Forbes philanthropy score displayed. Fondation Bettencourt Schueller is a French 'fondation reconnue d'utilité publique' (1987), files no US 990-PF; endowment/asset figure was not in the pages read (full 2024 PDF, 6.1 MB, not parsed within budget - assetsBillions left null, needs-check). Giving Pledge: not seen as signatory; full-list check not performed within budget. Foundation activity is almost entirely France-focused; no country breakdown published beyond that.
